svg.title: How a task travels the agent mesh
svg.desc: Agents on a developer laptop, in Kubernetes on premises or in a cloud, on a SaaS platform or inside a sandbox hand each request to their local sam-node office. The first time, the office checks the sender's platform identity at the Registry (the control plane) and receives a passport (the Biscuit authority block: who the sender is and their memberships). For each errand the holder writes a mandate (an attenuation block) that can only narrow. Routers carry the sealed bag and cannot open it. The destination office for mcp://github, mcp://bigquery, inference://gemini, inference://claude, egress://generativelanguage.googleapis.com or a2a://partner-agent reads the passport, the law it already holds and the mandates, decides offline, inspects, and at a cloud border obtains a border pass from the Registry.
svg.text: How a task travels the mesh
Every parcel carries its sender's passport and a mandate for this errand.
Every office reads them and decides alone.

g.text: Not another gateway: Istio, agentgateway and kgateway ask SAM over ext_proc

svg.text: relay only · the bag is sealed between two offices, a router cannot open it

g.text: sam-control-plane · issues passports · writes the law and the watchlist · never touches a parcel
◌ law, watchlist and seal specimen reach every office on a timer

passport: who sends and their memberships, issued once by the Registry
mandate: written by the holder for this errand, narrower and shorter, never wider
sam-node, at the edge: reads passport, law and mandates offline, runs customs, gets a border pass at a cloud border
sam-router, at the core: admits passport holders, relays sealed bags, opens none
Registry = sam-control-plane: issues passports, writes the law and the watchlist. Asked once per sender and once per task at a cloud border, never per request.
✓ is the office's decision; nothing is written on the passport. Bring your own gateway (Istio, agentgateway, kgateway over ext_proc) and your own customs (any ext_proc processor).
